description: This file is a shell script used for testing and automating various scenarios related to Git promisor remote advertisement and partial clone features, including setup, cloning with different configurations, and verification of object presence and missing objects.

methods.name: check_missing_objects
methods.description: Checks the number of missing objects in the repository and compares to expected counts and object IDs.

methods.name: initialize_server
methods.description: Repacks the server repository, removes existing promisor files, creates a promisor pack with filtered objects, and verifies missing objects.

methods.name: copy_to_lop
methods.description: Copies specific objects from the server to the 'lop' repository based on object ID.
